name: Sikafloor-2350 ESD
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-2350 ESD: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-2350 ESD, April 2023, Version 03.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor-2350-esd.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-2350 ESD where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-2350 ESD is a 2-part self smoothing coloured electrostatic dissipative epoxy resin floor coating.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-2350 ESD may only be used by experienced professionals.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - The Product is used as a.
    - Smooth,Textured or Slip Resistant electrostatically conductive floor covering
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - The Product may only be used for interior applications.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-2350 ESD
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: 2-part epoxy electrostatic dissipative floor coating
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability.
    - Contributes towards satisfying Materials and Resources (MR) Credit: Building product disclosure and optimization — Environmental Product Declarations under LEED® v4
    - Contributes towards satisfying Materials and Resources (MR) Credit: Building Product Disclosure and Optimization — Material Ingredients under LEED® v4
    - Contributes towards satisfying Indoor Environmental Quality (EQ) Credit: Low-Emitting Materials under LEED® v4
    - Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) in accordance with EN 15804. EPD independently verified by Institut für Bauen und Umwelt e.V. (IBU)
    - Complies with the requirements of AgBB including the LCI-values (August 2018) for use in the indoor environment.
    - French regulation on indoor VOC emissions class A+
2.3 Approvals / certificates.
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 13813:2002 Screed material and floor screeds — Screed material — Properties and requirements — Synthetic resin screed material
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 1504-2:2004 Products and systems for the protection and repair of concrete structures — Surface protection systems for concrete — Coating
    - Slip resistance DIN 51130, Roxeler, Certificate No. 020243-20-3
    - Slip resistance, DIN 51130, Roxeler, Certificate No. 020243-20-2
    - Slip resistance DIN 51130, Roxeler, Certificate No. 020243-20-2a
    - Approval for ESD protective products acc. IEC 61340- 5-1,RISE Institute, No. ESD-20-0023
    - Particle emission ISO 14644-1, Sikafloor®-2350 ESD, CSM Fraunhofer, SI 2011-1195
    - Insulation Resistance DIN VDE 0100-600, kiwa, Test report No. P 12819-E
    - Outgassing behavior ISO 14644-15, CSM Statement of Qualification, Fraunhofer IPA
    - Outgassing Behavior, VOC/ SVOC, CSM Fraunhofer, Certificate No. SI 2011-1195
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 15804: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Sustainability (p.1).
    - EN 13813:2002: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1504-2:2004: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - DIN 51130: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ISO 14644-1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ISO 14644-15: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN ISO 868: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore D Hardness (p.2).
    - EN ISO 5470-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Abrasion resistance (p.2).
    - EN ISO 604: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - ISO 178: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength in flexure (p.2).
    - EN 1542: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
    - EN 1081: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Electrostatic behaviour (p.3).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Reliable long term conductivity
    - Meets ESD requirements
    - Low VOC emissions
    - Good resistance to abrasion
    - Low odour during application
    - Very good mechanical resistance
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Epoxy
2.7 Appearance and colour.
    | Part A | coloured liquid |
    | Part B | transparent liquid |
    | Cured colour | Available in the approximate colours |
    | RAL 1014, RAL 3012, RAL 5024, RAL 6010, RAL 6020, RAL 6021, RAL 6027, RAL 6033, RAL 6034, RAL 7005, RAL 7015, RAL 7016, RAL 7030, RAL 7032, RAL 7035, RAL 7040, RAL 7047 |
    | Exposure to direct sunlight |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note: When the product is exposed to direct sunlight, there may be some discolouration and colour variation. This has no influence on the function and performance of the coating.
2.8 Density.
    | Part A | ~1.70 kg/l |
    | Part B | ~1.00 kg/l |
    | Mixed Product | ~1.5 kg/l |
2.9 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Solid content by mass: ~100 %
    - Solid content by volume: ~100 %
    - Tensile adhesion strength: > 1.5 N/mm² (failure in concrete) (EN 1542)
2.10 Shore D Hardness.
    | Cured 7 days at 23 °C | 80 |
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 868)
2.11 Abrasion resistance.
    | Cured 7 days at 23 °C | ~1.29 g, resin filled 20% |
    | with QS (H22/1000/1000) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 5470-1)
2.12 Compressive strength.
    | Cured 28 days at +23 °C | ~120 MPa |
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 604)
2.13 Tensile strength in flexure.
    | Cured 28 days at +23 °C | ~30 MPa |
    Test method printed: (ISO 178)
2.14 Electrostatic behaviour.
    | Resistance to ground | Rg < 10⁹ Ω |
    | Typical average resistance | Rg ≤ 10⁵ Ω to 10⁷ Ω |
    | to ground |
    | Body voltage generation | < 100 V |
    | System Resistance (per- | < 10⁹ Ω |
    | son/floor/footwear) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note Measurement results can be affected by ESD clothing, ambient conditions, measurement equipment, cleanliness of the floor and the test personnel.
    Test method printed: (IEC 61340-4-1)
    Test method printed: (EN 1081)
    Test method printed: (IEC 61340-4-5)
    Test method printed: (IEC 61340-4-5)
2.15 Service temperature.
    | Short-term, maximum 7 days | +60 °C |
    | IMPORTANT |
    | Simultaneous mechanical and chemical strain |
    | 1. Do not expose the Product to chemical or mechanical strain at elevated temperatures |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    While the Product is exposed to temperatures up to +60 °C, simultaneous mechanical or chemical strain may cause damage to the Product.
2.16 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 18 months from date of production
2.17 Storage conditions. The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 03.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Mixing ratio.
    | Part A : Part B (by weight) | 82 : 18 (by weight) |
4.3 Consumption.
    | Coating system | Product | Consumption |
    | Wearing layer | Sikafloor®-2350 ESD | 1.5 kg/m² to 2.5 kg/m² |
    | filled with 20 % quartz sand 0.1-0.3 mm |
    | Slip resistant broadcast | Sikafloor®-2350 ESD | 1.1 kg/m² filled with 20 |
    | layer | % quartz sand 0.1-0.3 |
    | mm |
    | Seal coat over broad- | Sikafloor®-2350 ESD | 0.8 kg/m² |
    | cast substrates |
    | Textured layer | Sikafloor®-2350 ESD | 0.7 kg/m² to 0.8 kg/m² |
    | with ~2 % (by weight) |
    | Sika® Extender T |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.
4.4 Pot Life.
    | +15 °C | 40 minutes |
    | +20 °C | 25 minutes |
    | +30 °C | 15 minutes |
    Note: Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions, particularly temperature and relative humidity.
4.5 Applied product ready for use.
    | Temperature | Foot traffic | Light traffic | Full cure |
    | +30 °C | ~16 hours | ~36 hours | ~3 days |
    | +20 °C | ~24 hours | ~48 hours | ~4 days |
    | +15 °C | ~48 hours | ~3 days | ~7 days |
    Note: Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions, particularly temperature and relative humidity.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature.
    | Minimum | +15 °C |
    | Maximum | +30 °C |
5.3 Ambient air temperature.
    | Minimum | +15 °C |
    | Maximum | +30 °C |
5.4 Relative air humidity.
    | Maximum | 80 % r.h. |
5.5 Dew point. Beware of condensation. The substrate and uncured applied product must be at least +3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the surface of the applied product. Low temperatures and high humidity conditions increase the probability of blooming.
5.6 Substrate temperature.
    | Minimum | +15 °C |
    | Maximum | +30 °C |
5.7 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.
5.8 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Shore D Hardness: Cured 7 days at 23 °C | 80 (EN ISO 868)
    - Abrasion resistance: Cured 7 days at 23 °C | ~1.29 g, resin filled 20%; with QS (H22/1000/1000) (EN ISO 5470-1)
    - Compressive strength: Cured 28 days at +23 °C | ~120 MPa (EN ISO 604)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: Cured 28 days at +23 °C | ~30 MPa (ISO 178)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: > 1.5 N/mm² (failure in concrete) (EN 1542)
    - Electrostatic behaviour: Resistance to ground | Rg < 10⁹ Ω; Typical average resistance | Rg ≤ 10⁵ Ω to 10⁷ Ω; to ground; Body voltage generation | < 100 V; System Resistance (per- | < 10⁹ Ω; son/floor/footwear); Note Measurement results can be affected by ESD clothing, ambient conditions, measurement equipment, cleanliness of the floor and the test personnel. (IEC 61340-4-1) (EN 1081) (IEC 61340-4-5) (IEC 61340-4-5)
5.9 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.10 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-2350 ESD, April 2023, Version 03.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor-2350-esd.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-2350 ESD/ 2350 ESD Thixo Part B, version 19/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikafloor-2350esd2350esdthixopartb.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-2350 ESD Part A substrate, version 15/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/MSDS%20Sikafloor-2350%20ESD%20Part%20A%20Substrate%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 03.02).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
